text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — spike of 401/403 from svc-proxy in us-east-1. Suspected token replay + noisy log forwarder activity. Creating incident thread. Please ack oncall.

alice: ack. I'm oncall for infra. pulling recent logs and metrics now.

bob: quick read — seeing repeated token-like fragments in the log-forwarder stdout for svc-proxy. multiple truncated token fragments, originating from staging instances (stg-*) and forwarded to `s3://staging-logs-archive`. suspect log-forwarder config leak.

carla: can we isolate the forwarder? block outbound S3 for the staging cluster until we know more. also we should rotate any staging service tokens asap.

dinesh: starting containment: adding egress deny rule for staging subnets to S3 in the firewall policy. running rotation script for svc-proxy staging token now: `./infra/rotate_service_token --service svc-proxy --env staging --force`

sec-eng: noted. from quick sampling the fragments look like auth header fragments, not full tokens. low probability of full token exfil but we must assume compromise of any partials until keys are rotated. recommend: 1) stop log-forwarder, 2) rotate staging svc tokens, 3) scrub S3 objects matching `svc-proxy` pattern, 4) run_scan for tenant ids.

alice: support: prep a short internal comms draft for customer-facing teams — say "no customer impact observed, investigation ongoing" until we confirm. legal: please standby in case PII surfaces. @sec-eng loop in for forensic details.

bob: forensic snippet (sample):
```
[stg-03] 2026-03-18T02:12:14Z INFO forwarder: sending chunk to s3://staging-logs-archive/2026/03/18/part-0001.gz
[stg-03] 2026-03-18T02:12:15Z DEBUG http: Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOi...trunc...XyZ
```
This shows truncation around the header boundary. Looks like the forwarder was not masking headers.

ops-bot: rollback action triggered — `log-forwarder` rolled back from v3.4.2 -> v3.4.1 in staging (reason: suspected header leak).

carla: good. also open a scrub job for `s3://staging-logs-archive/*svc-proxy*` and set lifecycle to quarantine copies for investigation before deletion.

dinesh: rotation completed for staging svc-proxy token, key sync to dependent services started. scrub job queued (job id: scrub-4112), ETA ~12m. egress block still active. :white_check_mark:

sec-eng: running quick grep for tenant ids and PII — initial scan shows no clear customer identifiers in the affected objects, but running a deeper content scan now. will update within 30m.

alice: handing this to @dinesh for final cleanup and to stay on watch for the next 2 hours. I'll draft a short internal update and notify product & support.

bob: next steps for post-mortem: 1) fix forwarder to redact Authorization headers by default, 2) add unit test to prevent header leakage, 3) add alert rule for forwarder sending Authorization header strings to S3.

carla: filing incident tracker INC-2026-042 for follow-up, assign to eng-logging + sec-eng for the post-mortem.

alice: thanks team. please log any forensic artifacts to the incident ticket. staying on until scrub job result.

dinesh: scrub job finished: 14 objects removed, 2 quarantined for further review (see scrub-4112). egress rule remains until midnight UTC. handing over to day oncall. last check-in here.

sec-eng: verified no customer-facing tokens leaked per current scan. will do final sweep and close when clean.

ops-bot: incident status updated -> "contained".

alice: closing thread for now — will publish post-mortem once sec-eng + eng-logging complete the root cause and remediation tasks. :lock:
